description: All 27 corpus 1.3 rows preserved, with three synthetic header-consistency witnesses derived from the existing Raven experimental profile R6/R13. Local Week 3 candidate; no external-spec certification or transaction-safety claim.

lineage.additional_vectors: Three witnesses from the reviewed 2026-09-30 Conformance Challenge Lab; original lab provenance retained. Local candidate integration is a separate review.

vectors.rationale: Valid real legacy transfer (kit-generated) must ACCEPT as legacy.

vectors.normative_clause: The v1 VersionByte is 129 (0x81), distinguishing v1 from legacy and v0.
vectors.rationale: Valid synthetic v1 transfer (version byte 0x81 at offset zero, SIMD-0385) must ACCEPT as v1. A pre-v1 parser misreads 0x81 as a short-vec continuation byte.

vectors.rationale: v0 with one address-lookup-table entry must ACCEPT as v0; parsers that end the v0 message at the instruction list reject it as trailing bytes.
vectors.provenance: synthetic: real v0 fixture + documented lookup section appended (Solana docs v0 layout)
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R8 structure (legacy/v0): account keys short-vec (32B each), 32B blockhash, instructions short-vec [program_index u8][accounts short-vec u8][data short-vec u8]; every account index and program index must be < total addressable accounts (static + lookup-table-loaded for v0). v0 only: lookup-table short-vec follows instructions [32B table address][writable indexes short-vec][readonly indexes short-vec]. Legacy has no lookup section.

vectors.specification: SIMD-0385 Transaction V1 Format (https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0385-transaction-v1.md)
vectors.spec_digest_scope: SHA-256 of the committed UTF-8 clause snapshot; the mutable branch response hash at retrieval is recorded inside that snapshot.
vectors.normative_clause: SIMD-0385 forbids trailing data after v1 signatures; this Raven profile explicitly extends exact consumption to the v0 fixture in this vector.
vectors.rationale: Five garbage bytes appended after a valid v0 transaction must REJECT (trailing_bytes). NOTE: @solana/kit 8.3.0's own decoder tolerates trailing bytes — this vector demonstrates that codec-level decode success is not admission hygiene.
vectors.provenance: derived: real v0 fixture + 5 trailing 0xAA

vectors.rationale: Version byte 0x82 (version 2) at offset zero is reserved/unsupported; must REJECT, not optimistic-accept a future format.
vectors.provenance: derived: v1 fixture version byte flipped 0x81→0x82
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R3 envelope_version: if decoded[0] === 0x81 the transaction is v1 (version byte at offset zero, SIMD-0385). If decoded[0] >= 0x80 and != 0x81 reject unsupported_version (0x80 reserved at offset zero; 0x82..0xFF = versions 2..127 not supported). A first byte >= 0x80 can never be a canonical short-vec signature count, so no valid legacy/v0 transaction is misclassified.

vectors.rationale: Message prefix 0x83 (message version 3) after a valid signature section must REJECT.
vectors.provenance: derived: v0 fixture message prefix 0x80→0x83
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R5 message_version (legacy/v0 family): after signatures, message[0] === 0x80 means v0; message[0] with MSB clear means legacy; message[0] MSB set with any other value rejects unsupported_version.

vectors.rationale: Signature count 1 encoded non-canonically as 81 00. Under the post-SIMD-0385 envelope convention a leading 0x81 IS the v1 version byte, so this is a malformed v1 transaction; a stale pre-v1 parser reads it as count=1 and ACCEPTs. Catches non-minimal-encoding tolerance and version ambiguity together.
vectors.provenance: derived: legacy fixture sig-count byte replaced by non-minimal two-byte encoding
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R3 envelope_version: if decoded[0] === 0x81 the transaction is v1 (version byte at offset zero, SIMD-0385). If decoded[0] >= 0x80 and != 0x81 reject unsupported_version (0x80 reserved at offset zero; 0x82..0xFF = versions 2..127 not supported). A first byte >= 0x80 can never be a canonical short-vec signature count, so no valid legacy/v0 transaction is misclassified. R4 sigcount_envelope (legacy/v0 family): read the signature count as a short-vec (compact-u16) in CANONICAL minimal encoding; reject non_canonical_shortvec otherwise. Reject truncated if fewer than 64*count signature bytes follow.

vectors.rationale: Signature count edited 1→2 without adding a signature must REJECT.
vectors.provenance: derived: legacy fixture count byte 0x01→0x02
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R4 sigcount_envelope (legacy/v0 family): read the signature count as a short-vec (compact-u16) in CANONICAL minimal encoding; reject non_canonical_shortvec otherwise. Reject truncated if fewer than 64*count signature bytes follow. R7 signature_count_binding: the transaction's signature vector length must equal header.num_required_signatures exactly. (Profile rule, consistent with runtime sanitize.)

vectors.requirement: R9 v1 duplicate rejection (docs version matrix)
vectors.rationale: v1 rejects duplicate static account addresses; legacy/v0 allow them (V05). Parsers that apply one rule set to all versions diverge here.
vectors.provenance: derived: dest account bytes replaced by payer bytes in real v1 fixture
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R9 structure (v1, GROUPED layout per SIMD-0385 proposal text, confirmed against @solana/kit 8.3.0 encoder output): version(0x81) | legacyHeader(3) | configMask u32 LE | lifetimeSpecifier(32) | numInstructions u8 | numAddresses u8 | addresses[N*32] | configValues | InstructionHeaders[numInstructions x (programAccountIndex u8, numInstructionAccounts u8, numInstructionDataBytes u16 LE)] | InstructionPayloads[numInstructions x (accountIndexes[numInstructionAccounts] ++ instructionData[numInstructionDataBytes])] | signature tail of exactly header.num_required_signatures x 64 raw bytes (no short-vec count — count implicit). ALL InstructionHeaders come first, THEN ALL InstructionPayloads concatenated; the interleaved header-then-payload-per-instruction shape is NOT v1. configMask bits: 0b11 = priorityFeeLamports (u64, both bits must be set together), 0b100 = computeUnitLimit (u32), 0b1000 = loadedAccountsDataSizeLimit (u32), 0b10000 = heapSize (u32); values positional in that field order. Reject config_mask_invalid on partial fee bits (mask & 3 == 1 or 2) or any unknown bit above 0b10000. v1 rejects duplicate static accounts (SIMD-0385: 'It is a sanitization failure for this array to contain any duplicates'). v1 has NO address lookup tables.

vectors.rationale: v1 heapSize 16384 is below the 32 KiB minimum — a sanitization failure per Solana docs. kit 8.3.0 refuses to BUILD this (client-side validation), so bytes are derived by single-field surgery on the real fixture.
vectors.provenance: derived: heap value 65536→16384 in real v1 fixture (kit refuses to emit this)
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R10 heap_bounds: a present v1 heapSize must be a multiple of 1024 in [32768, 262144]; reject config_heap_out_of_range otherwise (Solana docs: out-of-range heap is a sanitization failure).

vectors.rationale: Non-base64 input must REJECT, not coerce or accept.

vectors.normative_clause: R2 base64: reject malformed_base64 unless strict RFC 4648 base64 decoding succeeds (alphabet + correct padding + round-trip length).

vectors.rationale: Object without exactly the tx_base64 key must REJECT (error-vs-refusal hygiene).
vectors.provenance: synthetic
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R1 input_shape: reject malformed_input unless the input is a JSON object with exactly one key, tx_base64, a string.

vectors.specification: Raven Solana transaction-version profile invocation contract
vectors.spec_digest_scope: SHA-256 of the committed profile JSON named by policy_source.
vectors.normative_clause: The profile invocation input is a JSON object with exactly one key, tx_base64, whose value is a string; every other input shape is rejected.
vectors.rationale: A valid legacy transaction plus an unexpected input key must REJECT; deleting only the exact-key guard changes this witness from refusal to admission.
vectors.provenance: derived: V01 valid legacy fixture plus one unexpected input key

vectors.specification: SIMD-0385 Transaction V1 Format (https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0385-transaction-v1.md)
vectors.spec_digest_scope: SHA-256 of the committed UTF-8 clause snapshot; the mutable branch response hash at retrieval is recorded inside that snapshot.
vectors.normative_clause: All NumInstructions instruction headers precede the concatenated instruction payloads; payload lengths come from the corresponding headers.
vectors.rationale: Real kit-generated v1 with TWO instructions. SIMD-0385 groups ALL InstructionHeaders then ALL InstructionPayloads; with 1 instruction the grouped and interleaved layouts are byte-identical, so only a 2+ instruction vector can catch a wrong-layout parser. Pre-repair (v0.1.0 profile) this vector was falsely REJECTed.
vectors.provenance: real: kit-generated offline, synthetic keys

vectors.specification: SIMD-0385 Transaction V1 Format (https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0385-transaction-v1.md)
vectors.spec_digest_scope: SHA-256 of the committed UTF-8 clause snapshot; the mutable branch response hash at retrieval is recorded inside that snapshot.
vectors.normative_clause: The wire layout places the complete InstructionHeaders array before the complete InstructionPayloads array; an interleaved header-payload layout does not match that format.
vectors.rationale: Byte-reorder of V16 into the interleaved header-then-payload-per-instruction shape: identical length, identical byte multiset, layout is the ONLY variable. Must REJECT. kit 8.3.0 decodes it structurally (payload byte sums are preserved) — codec decode success is not admission hygiene, again.
vectors.provenance: derived: documented header/payload reorder of the real V16 fixture

vectors.rationale: v1 num_required_signatures (4) > num_addresses (3) must REJECT header_inconsistent. Kills mutants that delete the v1 header check.
vectors.provenance: derived: header byte surgery on real V16 fixture
vectors.specification: Raven experimental transaction-version profile (local policy; not external-spec certification)
vectors.normative_clause: R6 header_consistency (all versions): num_readonly_signed < num_required_signatures (equality is a sanitization failure — it would make the fee payer readonly — so num_required_signatures >= 1 is implied); num_required_signatures <= account_count; (num_required_signatures - num_readonly_signed) + num_readonly_unsigned <= account_count. (Agave message sanitize semantics; SIMD-0385 restates the equality rule for v1.)

vectors.specification: Solana documentation — Transaction Pipeline (https://solana.com/docs/core/transactions/transaction-pipeline)
vectors.spec_digest_scope: SHA-256 of the committed UTF-8 clause snapshot; the mutable live HTML body hash at retrieval is recorded inside that snapshot.
vectors.normative_clause: Sanitization requires the number of transaction signatures to match num_required_signatures in the message header.
vectors.rationale: Signature vector length (2) != header.num_required_signatures (1) with BOTH signatures present — parses cleanly to the binding check, unlike V11 which fails earlier as truncation. Kills mutants that delete the count binding.
vectors.provenance: derived: legacy fixture sig-count 1->2 with duplicated signature slot

vectors.specification: SIMD-0385 Transaction V1 Format (https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0385-transaction-v1.md)
vectors.spec_digest_scope: SHA-256 of the committed UTF-8 clause snapshot; the mutable branch response hash at retrieval is recorded inside that snapshot.
vectors.normative_clause: A v1 transaction fails sanitization when an instruction account index is greater than or equal to NumAddresses.
vectors.rationale: v1 instruction account index 99 >= num_addresses 3 must REJECT. kit decodes it structurally — bounds are sanitization, not decoding. Kills mutants that delete the bounds check.
vectors.provenance: derived: payload byte surgery on real V16 fixture

vectors.specification: SIMD-0385 Transaction V1 Format (https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0385-transaction-v1.md)
vectors.spec_digest_scope: SHA-256 of the committed UTF-8 clause snapshot; the mutable branch response hash at retrieval is recorded inside that snapshot.
vectors.normative_clause: The maximum v1 transaction size specified by SIMD-0385 is 4096 bytes.
vectors.rationale: Fully well-formed v1 transaction of 4202 bytes (> 4096) must REJECT size_cap_exceeded. Valid-except-size construction: a padded vector would also be caught by R11 exact-consumption and could not detect a mutant that deletes only the size cap — this one can.
vectors.provenance: synthetic: programmatically constructed, fully-formed except total size

vectors.rationale: Fully well-formed legacy transaction of 1257 bytes (> 1232) must REJECT size_cap_exceeded. Valid-except-size for the same mutant-detection reason as V21.

vectors.normative_clause: R12 size_caps: legacy/v0 total <= 1232 bytes; v1 total <= 4096 bytes (Solana docs version matrix; SIMD-0385 transaction constraints).

vectors.specification: SIMD-0385 Transaction V1 Format (https://github.com/solana-foundation/solana-improvement-documents/blob/main/proposals/0385-transaction-v1.md)
vectors.spec_digest_scope: SHA-256 of the committed UTF-8 clause snapshot; the mutable branch response hash at retrieval is recorded inside that snapshot.
vectors.normative_clause: A transaction fails sanitization when num_readonly_signed_accounts is greater than or equal to num_required_signatures because the fee payer would be readonly.
vectors.rationale: num_readonly_signed == num_required_signatures is a sanitization failure per SIMD-0385 ('As in prior formats... equality fails — it would imply the fee payer is readonly'). v0.1.0 of this profile allowed equality; 0.2.0 rejects it. Kills mutants that weaken the strict inequality.
vectors.provenance: derived: header byte surgery on real V16 fixture
